zones.name: South Valley Insertion Trail
zones.description: Player Start at (350, 10) at southern base of the hill; winding dirt road flanked by rock outcrops and pine cover, guarded by Tripwire Alarms M03_T1_01 (335, 260) and M03_T1_02 (375, 285), and patrolled by 4x E1 Militia Grunts.

zones.name: West Ravine & Flanking Woods
zones.description: Dense foggy timberland offering a stealth bypass around the main garrison camp, with gravel/can Noise Traps M03_T8_01 (185, 340) and M03_T8_02 (215, 430) along narrow rock defiles.

zones.name: East Garrison Camp & Officer Quarters
zones.description: Fenced barracks compound housing 2x E3 Radio Officers (one carrying the S1 Codebook), 4x E1 Grunts, 2x E2 Cobalt Grunts, and a 3-room Command Hut (R1 Entry with locker, R2 Control Room with camera monitor M03_MON_01 and Alarm Panel M03_ALM_01, R3 Officer Office with Codebook safe).

zones.name: Generator Substation & Industrial Yard
zones.description: Concrete-walled power yard directly south of the relay tower containing Diesel Generator (prop_generator_diesel_a), large Fuel Tank (prop_fuel_tank_large) at (375, 485) (detonating it chains into destroying the Relay Tower!), Breaker Box (prop_breaker_box_a) powering the turret/searchlight grid, and panning Security Camera M03_CAM_01 at (410, 460).

zones.name: North Relay Tower Summit
zones.description: High-security fenced summit enclosing the giant steel Radio Relay Tower at (370, 600) (O1), defended by 2x Searchlight Towers M03_T10_01 (310, 545) and M03_T10_02 (430, 545) (S2), 2x Automated Sentry Turrets M03_T9_01 (345, 575) and M03_T9_02 (395, 575), 6x E2 Cobalt Grunts, and 2x E12 Sentries.

primary.title: Destroy relay tower at (370, 600) by planting C4 on the tower legs OR detonating the generator fuel tank

secondary.title: Steal codebook from compound officer in Zone C

events.description: At elapsed >= 600s, dusk transitions to full night and all floodlights/searchlights power on.
If alert_level == 3 and the radio operator reports for 10s, spawns 2 reinforcement squads along the main road after 45s.

silent.name: Silent Route (West Ravine Climb, Rear Summit Fence Cut & C4 Plant)
silent.description: Insert at (350, 10), angle northwest into Zone B West Ravine (170, 260) and (200, 480) bypassing Noise Traps M03_T8_01/02, cut rear summit fence at (270, 600), plant C4 on Relay Tower legs at (370, 600), and exfiltrate down the eastern slope via (640, 600) to (640, 40).

technical.name: Technical Route (Zone C Camera Disable, Zone D Breaker Shutoff & Fuel Manifold Sabotage)
technical.description: Advance from (350, 10) to Zone C Command Hut corridor (515, 240) to steal Codebook (S1) and disable camera monitor M03_MON_01, enter Zone D Substation at (370, 485) to shut down breaker M03_BREAKER_BOX_D (disabling T9 turrets & T10 searchlights), reach Relay Tower at (370, 600), and descend via (640, 600) to (640, 40).

loud.name: Loud Route (Ridge Searchlight Snipe, Zone D Breach & Fuel Tank Chain-Detonation)
loud.description: Advance up South Valley Trail from (350, 10) to central ridge overwatch (370, 310), snipe Searchlights M03_T10_01/02, breach Zone D Substation at (375, 485) to detonate Fuel Tank (chaining into Relay Tower at (370, 600)), and fight down the eastern slope via (640, 600) to (640, 40).

structures.description: Giant steel Radio Relay Tower at (370, 600) — Primary Objective O1 (destroy via C4 on tower legs or chain-detonation from Zone D fuel tank).

structures.description: Substation transformer house supporting panning Security Camera M03_CAM_01 at (410, 460) and Breaker Box.
